description:
## New Features

- Added back `double-back-to-close` patch. This fixes the back button issue.

## Bug Fixes

- Fixed the following patches (they produced an error while patching)
  - `hide-create-button`
  - `hide-mix-playlists`
  - `hide-endscreen-cards`
  - `hide-info-cards`
  - `hide-auto-player-popup-panels`
  - `enable-seekbar-tapping`
  - `disable-haptic-feedback`
  - `enable-wide-searchbar`
  - `hide-auto-captions`
  - `optimize-resource`

- Fixed `switch-create-notification` patch to work as intended
- Fixed the remaining non-working parts of `sponsorblock` patch (sponsor bars and buttons)

## Changes

- Included `sponsorblock` patch into the default patch selection
- Modified `return-youtube-dislike` patch to work on the old (default) layout
- Updated the first run message
- Merged commits from upstream

## Removed Features

- Removed the following patches (they target features not present on v16.40.36)
  - `hide-filmstrip-overlay`
  - `hide-startup-shorts-player`
  - `remove-player-button-background`

- Removed `hide-stories` patch as Stories are gone

### Note
The sponsorblock feature causes some issues with videos (such a certain video sections repeating infinitely after skipping a sponsor), but I can only trigger them on emulators. Unfortunately I don't have a physical Android 5 device so I'm unable to determine if the issues are also present on physical Android 5 devices.

There are other issues present on emulators that I've confirmed are not present on physical Android 5 devices so the sponsorblock bug might not be present at all.
If you encounter the sponsorblock bug on a physical Android 5 device, disable sponsorblock and open an issue.
